title: MonsterBox ai-config/stt-config.json
description: Per-character ElevenLabs STT / microphone configuration. Only microphonePartId is required so that the audio pipeline can resolve a capture device. All other fields (model, language, VAD) are service-layer tunable and optional. Capture format/rate/channels are fixed by the capture layer (16 kHz mono PCM16) and are deliberately not configurable here. Leading-underscore keys (_preset, _comment, etc.) are metadata.
